/bin/bash -lc "set -o pipefail
for q in \\
  '\"AKSHAT COLLEGE SITPURA SATNA\"' \\
  'Akshat College Sitpura Satna official website' \\
  'site:mp.gov.in \"Akshat College\" Satna' \\
  'site:ac.in \"Akshat College\" Satna'; do
